items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Jerry Gray scored the original 'Begin the Beguine,' and Artie used to give him a chart to go by... Then he had Jerry Gray on his side.

ctx.x: Jerry Gray scored the original "Begin the Beguine," and Artie used to give him a chart to go by, and how to style it, and then Jerry Gray would arrange.
Oh, so he was in there doing the arranging then.
